prompt: In August of 2024, what is the first name of the mayor of the U.S. state capital city who attended the same university as at least one U.S. president and whose city is home to an outgoing or former full member of the Big 12 Conference
answer:
The first name is **Leirion**—**Leirion Gaylor Baird**, mayor of Lincoln, Nebraska.

She attended **Stanford University**, as did former U.S. President **Herbert Hoover**. Lincoln is home to the University of Nebraska–Lincoln Cornhuskers, a former full member of the Big 12 Conference.
